description_en: Verifies the C2PA digital signature in an image and returns related information
description_zh: 验证图片中的C2PA数字签名并返回相关信息
name: VerifyImageSignature

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be verified. Specify either `ImageUrl` or `ObjectKey`. At least one must be provided
parameters.help_zh: 待验证图片的 URL 地址。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url
